content: Yawey Benwokrayekwong Bininj Nawu Israel Benkebmawahmeng Kore Yingkihkarremarnbom
Exodus 14:1-4

Wanjh Yawey bimarneyimeng Moses, yimeng, “Yibenmarneyimen bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng kabirridurndeng kabirriyo darnkih kabolkngeyyo Pi Hahiroth, kubulkayh ngarre kabolkngeyyo Migdol dja Manbokurlba. Birriyuwn kurrula darnkih borledmikenh ngarre kabolkngeyyo Baal Zephon.
Wanjh Pharaoh kaluk kayime bu ngudda bininj nawu Israel ngunkebmawahmeng ngurridjalwakbun, dja minj ngudda baleh ngurriyime, kubolkdarleh ngunbalhmeng ngudberre.

Kunmekbe nungka kayime, dja ngaye Yawey ngakangerayekwon dja nungka ngunkadjung ngudberre. Kaluk bu ngaye ngabenbun Pharaoh dja miwadj nuye rowk wanjh ngaye ngangeykukenmen, dja kumekbe wanjh bininj nawu Egytpbeh kaluk kabirriburrbun bu ngaye Yawey.” Wanjh bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng birrikurduyimeng bu nungka yimeng bedberre.
Pharaoh Dja Bininj Nuye Bindikadjuy Bininj Nawu Israel Benkebmawahmeng
Exodus 14:5-14

Kaluk bu nungka nawu wohrnani kore Egypt, bu birrimarneyimeng bu bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng birrikelerlobmeng birriwam, wanjh nungka nawu Pharaoh dja bininj nuye nawu birrimarnedurrkmirri wanjh birrimayaliborledmeng bedberre dja birriyimeng, “Njale kuhni bu ngad karrikurduyime, bu karrbenmunkewe bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng, dja bedda minj mak kandimarnedurrkmirri?”
Wanjh kuhni Pharaoh yingkihkurrmeng chariot nuye dja mak benkang miwadj nuye birridjarrkwam, dja mak
birrikang chariots rowk ngarre Egypt kaluk 600 manu manwernhmak duninjh, dja bininj nawu birriwohrnani chariots ngarre rowk.
Dja Yawey bikangerayekwong Pharaoh nawu wohrnani kore Egypt ba kabindikadjung bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng bu bedda birrihdjalley minj birrimarnekeleniwirrinj Pharaoh.

Bedda bininj nawu Egytpbeh bindikadjuy, kaluk Pharaoh nuye djarrang, chariots dja bininj nawu chariots birridahkendi, djarrang bindidjurrkkani. Wanjh kaluk bindimarnebebmeng bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng kore birriyoy kore kurrula darnkih kabolkngeyyo Pi Hahiroth borledmikenh ngarre Baal-Zephon.

Bu Pharaoh dorrengh bindimarnebebmeng darnkih, wanjh bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng birriwohrnang wanjh bindinang bininj nawu Egytpbeh kabindimhkadjung, wanjh kunu birrikeleminj duninjh, dja bedda birrimarnekayhmeng Yawey.
Dja birrimarneyimeng Moses birriyimeng, “Yiddok kumidjyak kore Egypt bu ngudda kanbebkeng ba bu ngarridowen kondah kubolkdarleh? Njale ngudda kanmarnekurduyimeng bu kanbebkeng Egyptbeh?

Dja bu karrihni kore Egypt, ngad kuhni wanjh ngundimarneyimeng, ‘Kanbawo ngadberre, ngarrbendjalmarnedurrkmirri bininj nawu Egytpbeh.’ Wanjh kunmakniwirrinj bu ngarrbenmarnedurrkmiwirrinj, dja kunwarre bu kondah kubolkdarleh ngarridowen.”

Kuhni birriyimeng, wanjh Moses yimeng bedberre, “Yuwn ngurrikele, ngurridjaldin kelebuk, dja ngurrina bu Yawey ngunmarnedurrkmirri bolkkime ngunngehke. Dja bedda bininj nawu Egytpbeh ngudda ngurrbennan bolkkime, wanjh minj ngurriyawoyhbennan bu munguyh munguyh.
Yawey nungka kabenbun ngudberre, minj baleh ngurrikurduyime, ngurridjalngurdmen dja ngurridjaldin.”
Yawey Benngehkeng Bininj Nawu Israel Benkebmawahmeng Dja Benbom Bininj Nawu Egyptbeh
Exodus 14:15-31
Wanjh Yawey bimarneyimeng Moses, yimeng, “Njalekah kandikayhme? Yibenmarneyimen bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng kabirridjalle.
Yirrulkma kundulk ke, dja yibidwayhmen kaddumkah ngarre kurrula dja yibolarlma, ba ngudda bininj nawu Israel ngunkebmawahmeng ngurridjalle kubolkbuk kurorre kubulhdjarn kurrula.

Dja ngaye ngabenmarnbun bininj nawu Egytpbeh ba ngundiwidnan dja ngundidjalkadjung ngudberre, dja kaluk ngangeykukenmen bu ngabenbun rowk Pharaoh nuye bininj namirndewern, chariots nuye, dja bininj nuye nawu kabindidjurrkkan djarrang.
Dja bu kunmekbe ngayime ngangeykukenmen bu ngabenbun wanjh kunu bininj nawu Egytpbeh kabirriburrbun bu ngaye wanjh Yawey nawu nawernhkimuk duninjh.” Kuhni bu Yawey bimarneyimeng Moses.

Wanjh God nuye angel nawu benmarnedokmi bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng nawu mirnderey, wanjh borledmeng benmunkebuni, dja kunngol manbu djabdihdjabdi benmarnedokmi wanjh borledmeng danginj kubodme bedberre.

Kunmekbe danginj kubulkayh bedberre bininj nawu Egytpbeh dja bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng birribebbehmirnderri. Dja bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng benmarnebolkwolkani manmekbe kunngol, dja bininj nawu Egytpbeh benmarnebolkmarnbom kumunun rerrih. Wanjh kuhni minj baleh birriyimeninj bindimarnebebmeninj darnkih kukakkuyeng dja minj birriburrimeninj.

Wanjh Moses bidwayhmeng kaddumkah ngarre kurrula dja Yawey boyarlarrkeyi kurrula kukakkuyeng bu nungka kunmayorrkkimuk munkeweng koyekbeh, nungka bolkmarnbom kubolkbuk kore kurrula bu boyarlarrkeng bobebbehdi.
Dja bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng birridjalley dja birridjowkkeng kurrula kore kubolkbuk kanjdji, dja manu kurrula wernhbowayhmi kaddum kukun dja kudjakku bedberre.
Wanjh bininj nawu Egytpbeh bindikadjungi, nadjalwern rowk nawu Pharaoh nuye djarrang, chariots, dja bininj nawu bindidjurrkkani djarrang, wanjh djal bindikadjungi kore kubolkbuk kore kurrula.
Dja bu kumbarrhbuni, Yawey nawu di kaddum kore kunak dja kunngol manu djabdihdjabdi, wanjh nungka kanjdji bennang bininj nawu Egytpbeh nawu birrimirnderey, dja benmarnbom benkelehmeng.

Nungka marnbom nawu chariots bedberre kuyinyibmeninj, dja yeledj birrihdjalley birribarabuni, wanjh bedda bininj nawu Egytpbeh birriyimeng, “Aba bonj! Karrikelerlobmen karrbenbawon bininj nawu Israel, dja Yawey kabenbidyikarrme kanbun kadberre nawu Egyptbeh.”
Wanjh Yawey bimarneyimeng Moses, yimeng, “Yibidwayhmen kaddumkah ngarre kurrula ba kaborrurnderren kore bininj nawu Egytpbeh, chariots bedberre dja bininj nawu kabindidjurrkkan djarrang bedberre.”

Wanjh kunu Moses bidwayhmeng kaddumkah ngarre kurrula, wanjh bu kumbarrhbuni borrurnderrinj kore berrehboyen boyihboyimi, dja bininj nawu Egyptbeh bu yimankek birrikelerlobmeninj wanjh birridjalbebmeng kore kurrula, kumekbe Yawey benbom benyakwong rowk.

Kurrula borrurnderrinj, benbarrkbom chariots dja bininj nawu djarrang bindidjurrkkani dja namirndewern nuye Pharaoh nawu bindikadjuy kore kurrula, benkebngakkeng rowk. Minj nawohkudji darrkidniwirrinj birrimekbe bininj nawu Egytpbeh.
Dja bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng, bedda ngokkokenh birribebmi birridjalley kore kurrula kore kubolkbukni, bu manu kurrula wernhbowayhmi kaddum kukun dja kudjakku bedberre.

Kuhni kunbarnangarra wanjh Yawey kurduyimeng bu benngehkeng kore bininj nawu Egytpbeh bindibuyi. Wanjh bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng bindinang bininj nawu Egytpbeh birrikukyoy kore kurrula ngarre kurrid.

Wanjh bu bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng birrikurdunang Yawey kurduyimeng kundulkarre kunkimuk dorrengh bu benbom bininj nawu Egytpbeh, wanjh bedda birrimarnekeleminj Yawey, dja birriwoybukwong Yawey dja mak birriwoybukwong Moses nawu bimarnedurrkmirri nuye.
